# GSAP 3.15.0 (self-hosted)

Copied unmodified from https://github.com/greensock/GSAP (dist/). Served from this site because the CSP only allows scripts from 'self'.

- gsap.min.js: core
- ScrollTrigger.min.js: scroll-driven animations
- SplitText.min.js: text splitting

Licence: GreenSock standard "no charge" license, https://gsap.com/standard-license

Not loaded by any page yet. Load only on the pages that use it, after style.css, and respect prefers-reduced-motion with gsap.matchMedia().
